notes.title: Changelist for r21320 aka Reloaded Edition
notes.content:
The Reloaded edition is coming out tomorrow. 

[i]New Features[/i]
[list]
[*]Two new playable characters. C-Zar and Frigg
[*]New Steel Soldier mission "Soldier Smash"
[*]New tent banners and ornaments
[*]New knives and guns
[*]Added tips to loading screen!
[*]Added a new buy material menu to Golden Gate to purchase materials you weren't awarded at the end of the last mission
[*]New reward menu in mission selection
[/list]

[i]Improvements[/i]
[list]
[*]Highlight the host of a multiplayer game
[*]Boss escape timers now only decay when players are in the zone
[*]Added asterisk mark on NPCs in camp that have new things to say
[*]Added a warning when ready to do primary missions
[*]Grenades and Shock Bombs can no longer be shot
[*]New camp minimap states
[*]New Save Ironside minimap
[*]Improved elevator reliability online
[*]Hide boss skull minimap icon when capture or killed
[*]Facility missions tweaks to make them easier
[*]Allow to melee on zip lines
[*]Respawn C4 in tutorial to prevent being stuck if not used to blow up the wall
[*]Disable double tap to roll by default
[*]Increased damage scaling of genades
[*]Balanced enemy HP in multiplayer to make them less bullet spungy
[*]Added a back to camp timer at the end of a mission
[*]Added an online AFK disconnect after 5 minutes of inactivity
[*]Reset back to gun after using the transceiver
[*]Balancing pass on knives and guns
[*]Allow rolling from crouch stance
[*]Added minimap markers for hostages, mission materials and target enemies
[*]Added key mission icon to highlight missions that unlock other missions
[*]During missions, removed limit on item quantity you can hold
[/list]

[i]Fixes[/i]
[list]
[*]Fixed new PS4 controller support
[*]Fixed shock bombs on first phase of Tiny Computer
[*]Fixed flashes in 3 or 4 player split screen
[*]Fixed end cutscene in split screen where it showed a gray screen
[*]Fixed mission marker in Explosivo Expedition
[*]Removed parachute modifier on hurt
[*]Fixed Lawless' talk animation as an hostage
[*]Fixed occasional gun jitter
[*]Removed menu glitch when dead and trying to open menus
[*]Fixed final boss mission complete popping up too early
[*]Fixed Harvest of the Titan's secret objective
[/list]

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459193/7dcf55025fe080c8e530c6f96c4f5c0858da92a2.gif[/img]

See you February 6th!

notes.content:
These changes are coming on both OSX and WIN.

[h1]Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Japanese localisation tweaks
[*] bootup should be a little faster on OSX
[*] overall improvement of network stability
[/list]

[list]
[*] Game would crash on start about 1 on 5 times with OSX 10.7
[*] OSX version crash pretty often when connecting to a multiplayer game
[*] updated SDL2 libs on OSX (there was some outstanding issues)
[*] matchmaking now use network protocol versionning instead of the version of the game, which means MAC and WIN user will get matched in public games.
[*] Potential fix for obscure NVorbis crashes on WIN
[/list]

notes.title: MERCENARY KINGS OUT TODAY ON STEAM FOR MAC AND PC!!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GLV-BGvufgw

CLAW better hide because the Mercenary Kings are on the move RIGHT NOW on Steam PC and Mac!!

Mercenary Kings is our biggest project yet : a 1-year project eventually turning into a 1.5+ year production. Sharing it with you in it’s full, completed glory is thrill for all of us here at Tribute Games!

Mercenary Kings, in it’s completed version is a run-and-gun mission-based platformer that offers you :

[list]
    [*]Over 100 missions!

    [*]Looting & Crafting! Grab materials from vanquished enemies or hidden all over Mandragora Island and use them to build new weapons and equipment!

   [*]Lots and LOTS of weapons : hundreds of knives! Over 300 gun parts to mix and match, leaving you to create the most powerful weapon possible!

    [*]Online and couch co-op! Enlist other mercenaries in the fight against Commander Baron and CLAW!

    [*]KICKING character animation by Paul Robertson!
    
    [*]Steam Cards! Exchange cool cards done with never-before-seen Mercenary Kings character art!

notes.title: MERCENARY KINGS : 2014!
notes.content:
As you’ve guessed it, Mercenary Kings will not be available for the 2013 calendar year. We’re extremely grateful and excited about people asking for the game on PS4
or the completed version on Steam. It was our hope to have it completed and in your hands for the holidays but the game is not in the shape it needs to be for it’s official, full release.

[h1]What’s going on?[/h1]

As of this moment, the game is content-completed. Every level and bosses are done and we’re in the process of polishing it (sound FX, localization).
It’s our most ambitious game (a year-long project is now a year and a half!) and that made it not only longer to develop but also to shape it up properly.

A lot of us at Tribute Game have worked at much larger companies where we worked on tie-in games or other projects that had to come out a certain date
regardless of whether they’re ready or not.

[h1]What’s the hold-up?[/h1]

The game runs, but we’re hard at work to make it run smoother! We’re committed to make sure we’re offering a SOLID multiplayer experience, both online and couch co-op.

Given the scope of the game and the level of quality we’re aiming for, fixing glitches and bugs, and fine tuning details takes more time than what we’re used to

[h1]When will the game come out?[/h1]
We’re aiming for an early 2014 release date. Again, we’re very close to the finish line !

[h1]What else?[/h1]
Mercenary Kings is remote play-compatible on Vita right out of the box! That’s pretty cool, right?

[img]https://31.media.tumblr.com/a089bd7c3382ef6abab4ed10229fa20e/tumblr_inline_my4agbwu8F1r2dlqv.jpg[/img]

Also, here’s a sneak peek at our animated intro! It’s pretty kick-ass!

[img]https://31.media.tumblr.com/df3b14905610f2e00840787ab2067f7e/tumblr_inline_my4ah5iTka1r2dlqv.png[/img]

Again, we’d like to thank you for your patience. We do not take lightly the privilege of having people be excited about the game and asking us about it everyday on social media! We’re working really hard to get it in the best possible shape and in your hands early 2014.
